description: Return the resulting fit between one hole class and one shaft class at the same nominal size, such as 12 H7/h6: the type (clearance, transition or interference), the minimum and maximum clearance, and the maximum interference. Values are millimetres. A negative minimum clearance means the fit can interfere. This reports the geometry of the fit, not whether it is the right choice for a joint, which depends on function and is the caller's decision.

nominal.description: Nominal size in millimetres, shared by the hole and shaft.

shaft.description: Shaft tolerance class, e.g. g6 or n6.

name: fit
title: Fit Between a Hole and a Shaft
